description: EspoCRM is a free, open-source CRM for managing all your company relationships: contacts, companies, leads, opportunities, projects, email and calendars in one customizable web application for sales and support teams.
name: EspoCRM
seoDescription: Deploy EspoCRM with Docker Compose on Dokploy — the open-source CRM for contacts, leads, opportunities and projects, with MariaDB and the cron daemon included.
